To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) water molecules in purple membranes are distributed in two layers of different thicknesses and dynamics; (b) the thickness and dynamics of the inner layer are correlated with the activity of the membrane; (c) the thickness of the outer layer is correlated with the hydration of the membrane, and is independent of activity; (d) the thickness of both layers is affected by the presence of lipids; (e) the thermal fluctuations of the membrane protein bacteriorhodopsine are correlated with

the hydration-dynamics-activation relation in the membrane of Halobacteria is due to the effect of hydration on the thermal dynamics of the membrane, and that thermal dynamics and activity are related by a mechanism of control of conformational changes by a valve-like function of the membrane.

the thermal fluctuations in the purple membrane are strongly affected by hydration, that the activity of bacterio- rhodopsin is strongly affected by hydration and thermal fluctuations, and that the bacteriorhodospin molecule is made of stiffer and softer subdomains, with the latter being involved in the activity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a fundamental problem of biology, namely how the activity of a membrane protein is controlled by the membrane structure and thermal fluctuations.
a general problem in biology: how the dynamics of the lipid-water environment of a biological macromolecule influences its activity.
the role of water in the activity of a membrane protein.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the activity of bacterirhodopsin is a direct function of the dynamics in the purple membrane, and that the dynamics is in turn strongly affected by the hydration state of the membrane.
water in the purple membrane is a key element for its activity.
the hydration dynamics of purple membrane is a major determinant in the control of its activity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the activity of the proton pump is correlated with membrane dynamics, which, in turn is controlled by the hydration state.

water is a crucial component of the purple membrane, not only because of its direct role in proton transport, but also because of its effects on thermal dynamics and on the conformation of the protein.
water is not just a solvent but a dynamic component that is involved in protein activity, through thermal dynamics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the activity of bacterio-opsin is strongly correlated to the thermal dynamics in the protein, and to the hydration of its lipid environment.
the thermal dynamics of the membrane is a crucial element in the activity of bacterio-rhodopsin.
hydration is a crucial factor in the thermal dynamics of the purple membrane, and thus in the activity of its protein.
